name: Luminas
description: Luminas in Clair Obscur Expedition 33 are passive abilities that are associated with Pictos. Luminas are only singular passive effects and do not come with the extra bonuses for combat stats that are included in a Pictos. There is no limit as to how many Luminas a character can equip but it requires you to have the required number of Lumina Points to equip them. By default, the total number of each character's Lumina Points is the same as the character's level. So, for example, if one of your characters is at Level 20, then that character has 20 Lumina Points that he or she can use to equip Luminas.

name: Locations
description: Locations for Clair Obscur Expedition 33 feature the many areas that players can explore throughout the game. name: Bosses
description: The Ultimate Sakapatate is an enemy with a large shield as tall as the boss on its left hand, and it wields a red furry mace in its right hand.
notes: Some encounters with Bosses can be quite challenging, and it can get quite frustrating when you keep dying trying to advance in the game but a fight with an enemy gets you stuck with no progress. Thankfully, in Expedition 33, there are a lot of things to help make fights better all from equipping the right Weapons and Skills, Pictos or Luminas, or even having the right lineup of characters in your party when you face off with that one pesky boss you can't get past. There is also a more comprehensive guide on Combat here.

When you are about to enter an area where you may face off with a boss, the entrance to said area will usually appear with a faint colour to indicate the approximate difficulty of the challenge you may encounter when fighting enemies and bosses in the area:
Red means that it will be difficult.
White means your level is appropriate
Blue means you've already been to the area

Make use of the Parry System. During combat, Enemies get one action per turn, and you can parry the enemy's attacks, which, if done correctly, launches a counterattack that deals damage to the boss. It also grants AP to the respective character (or the whole party). If you manage to perform a successful parry, it will launch a counterattack on the boss; both of which will be indicated on screen.

NG+ grants better boss drops! After finishing the main story once, you have the option to start over with New Game+. When you select the option to play again with NG+ you keep all your Characters, their stats, skills, Weapons, Pictos and Luminas, and Outfits. This option allows you to go through the story all over again, but the enemies and bosses will be far more challenging than before.

Of course, that doesn't come without its benefits. In NG+, boss drops are better than the ones you get on your first playthrough. You can also re-explore the world and find Pictos and Weapons that are tied to bosses and areas again in their locations and you'll be able to upgrade them to a higher level for free.

Each time this enemy attacks, it adds 2 to the number of bounces it does per attack sequence. First attack is 2 bounces.
Each attack sequence starts off slowly and builds up speed.
He will self-destruct after finishing the attack sequence consisting of 24 jumps. You do not need to perfectly parry/dodge any sequences. Then the fight ends.
Try using Heal on Parry on a character with high HP and Defense to survive (ideally Monoco so you can take its ability during Act II).

It's possible to use a shield-focused Monoco of any level to easily "defeat" the Continent Grosse Tete, with or without further help from a tanky build. For that end, it's recommended to stack as many Speed Pictos as possible, since shields can virtually only be placed by abilities like Cruler Barrier, hence the need for players to take turns. Boucharo can aid by providing Monoco with Rush every time the Bestial Wheel pointer goes to Agile (use Greater Rush if available).

If using Boucharo, the only skills needed to properly take on this "fight" with Monoco are Cruler Barrier, Abbest Wind and Potier Energy, cast as follows: Abbest Wind => Cruler Barrier => Cruler Barrier => Abbest Wind => Potier Energy.

Energising Turn alone ensures that Monoco gains back the AP needed to cast all skills in the Boucharo rotation suggested above. Alternatively, Dodger and Energising Pain can provide Monoco with some AP without the need for parrying.
In Medias Res makes it so the equipping character starts any fight with 3 Shields, giving a lot of wiggle room for just 10 Lumina Points.

related_rewards: You can find this enemy in the open area after going through the tunnel in the Open Playground. As you exit, head up the ramp to find 2 Licornes accompanied by a Barbasucette. Defeating this trio for the first time will reward you with the Damage Share.

From the Gestral Camp in Verso's Drafts, head outside where you can see a large duck toy on the water. Proceed to the grassy path to the left and follow it until you come across the wooden horse toy. You can find 3 Licornes on the right. Defeating this group for the first time will reward you with x1 Grandiose Chroma Catalyst.
info_lines: You can find this enemy in the open area after going through the tunnel in the Open Playground. As you exit, head up the ramp to find 2 Licornes accompanied by a Barbasucette. Defeating this trio for the first time will reward you with the Damage Share.

name: Mime
description: Mime is an Enemy in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Mime can be found throughout the Continent, wearing a striped black-and-white shirt and overalls. This enemy uses its mime abilities to protect itself from incoming damage and can be quite deadly in battle with its fast attacks. When fighting the Mime, try to fill its break bar as fast as possible to stun or break the enemy. Breaking a Mime enemy makes it vulnerable to the Expeditioner's attacks.
obtain_locations: You'll find the Mime in Lumiere when you reach near the docks where the Gommage takes place. When you approach Maelle and the kids, go right, and you'll see a stage where other residents are performing magic. From the stage, look to your right and you'll spot the Mime standing by the corner. Approach it and fight it. Defeating it will drop the Lumiere Music Record.

From the Grand Meadow Expedition Flag, head to the path on the left. At the edge of the cliff, look up to the next cliff ahead and grapple across. Follow the path down to an arena to face a Mime, defeat the Mime to obtain Baguette Outfit (Gustave) and Baguette Haircut (Gustave).

Towards the end of the main path in Flying Waters, where you will find a trail of corpses that will lead to a shadow of a gigantic enemy with extra-long limbs. Once you see this enemy, turn right and look for a path between the tall, kelp-looking plants. Climb the platform to find the Mime in a secluded area. This enemy drops a Short Haircut (Maelle).

In the Sanctuary Maze section, follow the main path until you reach an area of a destroyed wooden structure. Behind the structure, you can find a Mime that drops the Baguette Outfit (Lune) and Baguette Haircut (Lune).

From Francois' Cave checkpoint in Esquie's Nest, go inside the cave, then turn right, and use the rope to go up one level. Walk over to the edge, and you'll see a Mime near the water. Carefully jump down on the right side, then defeat this Mime to get Baguette Outfit (Sciel) and Baguette Haircut (Sciel).

In Sirene, progress through until you have been transported through a tunnel to reach an underground area. Go straight ahead and grapple through the platforms. Exit the archway and go straight ahead past a balcony to find the Mime in a small room. Defeat it to obtain Sirene Haircut (Lune).

From the Tainted Cliffs Expedition Flag, head up the stairs and get across to the other cliff. Follow the path all the way past the two forks in the path that splits to the right, keep going straight until you reach a fireplace-looking statue. Head to the left alcove and take the rope down to encounter the Mime, along with a Clair, and an Obscur. Defeat this group to obtain Voluminous Haircut (Maelle).
notes: The Mime can appear with different hairstyles and outfits and will drop rewards at various locations. When fighting the Mime, it will start its turn by protecting itself with shields, and they are quite tanky.

When fighting the Mime try to fill up its break bar as quickly as possible and perform a skill or gradient attack to break and stun the enemy. After it is stunned for the first time the Mime's Wall ability breaks and it permanently takes significantly more damage.

It only has two types of attacks: Hand-to-hand Combo: A three-hit combo. Perfect for parrying due to its slow movement. Strange Combo: The Mime uses an invisible hammer and quickly slams it towards its target four times. The first two hits are fast, succeeding slams, then it pauses for a while before slamming the weapon down for a third and fourth slow swing. Watch out for the first two attacks, you can parry them or dodge the first two hits and parry the 3rd and 4th hits.
Hand-to-hand Combo: A three-hit combo. Perfect for parrying due to its slow movement.

name: Petank
description: Petank is a Special Enemy in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Petank is a miniature enemy with the appearance of a destroyed orb with 2 legs. When you first encounter a Petank, it will try to flee, and you need to run after it and initiate the "First Strike" to prompt the fight. The first one can be found near the Entrance - Ancient Sanctuary checkpoint.
obtain_locations: Can be found near the Entrance checkpoint in the Ancient Sanctuary. Look over to the open field beyond the checkpoint, then run after the enemy and initiate the First Strike to fight Petank.
Can be found on the left side of the pond beside the narrow bridge to Esquie, lead it back to its platform and strike to fight Petank.

Can be found on the farm past the Old Farm Expedition Flag, head to the right behind the first shack. The Petank can be found to the side of the second shack down. Lead it back to it's platform and strike to fight Petank.

Can be found by the Battlefield Expedition Flag. From the flag, follow the wooden path away from the gate. The Petank can be found on a small dirt path to the right. Lead it back to it's platform and strike to fight Petank.
First, can be found past the Dancing Class Expedition Flag. From the flag, ride the flying disc at the far end, then enter the center path upon landing to find the Petank.
Second, can be found on a hidden area to the left of the Crumbling Path Expedition Flag. Head to the left from the flag and climb across the fallen pillar, take the rope down to find the Petank.

Can be found by a windmill in the Tainted Cliffs area. From the Expedition Flag, head up the stairs and grapple across and continue down the path. Continue ahead and you will find a windmill on the right, and the Petank in front of it.
notes: Petank's color corresponds to a certain color mechanic. Some of the mechanics can be bypassed with very extreme damage.
BLUE: Produces shields. Bring anyone with ability that bypasses or destroys shields instantly.
GREEN: Free-Aim the initial green orb. Then shoot the following floating green orbs. Petank will cast dizzy to make this more difficult.
RED: Must parry to delay fleeing.
YELLOW: Break bar fills quicker. Use moves that complement this, and break to prevent fleeing.
PURPLE: Summons adds that must be defeated before reattacking the Petank.
The name and attack patterns of the Pétank seems to reference the game pétanque, as the Pétanks attack by "throwing" metal balls.

name: Chromatic Portier
description: Chromatic Portier is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Portier is a boss that shares its appearance with the regular enemy, Portier, except it is more powerful. This boss holds on to two separate shields in each hand, but it can combine them together to form one shield that can protect it from incoming attacks, or use it offensively to attack its targets.

name: Chromatic Ramasseur
description: Chromatic Ramasseur is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Ramasseur will continuously attack the group, leaving you with limited attack options to either Parry, Dodge, or Avoid its moves at first. It can perform a combo with a Nevron arm and pull off a Mortal Hit that can take out a target with one hit.
info_lines: For this battle, you must parry its attacks to weaken it.

name: Chromatic Reaper Cultist
description: Chromatic Reaper Cultist is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Reaper Cultist is an optional boss that can be encountered by exploring The Continent, on an island northeast of the Coastal Cave. To reach this area, you’ll need to progress the story far enough to recruit Esquie and unlock the ability to destroy coral reefs.

name: Chromatic Troubadour
description: Chromatic Troubadour is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Troubadour wields a musical instrument that it uses to slam against its targets to inflict damage. This enemy has a visible weak point which is a single dot in the middle of its chest.
weak_spots: Single dot in the middle of its chest. Between the collar part.
info_lines: Available Weak Spot: Single dot in the middle of its chest. Between the collar part.

name: Clair Obscur
description: Clair Obscur is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Clair Obscur is an optional boss that can be found in the Tainted Lumiere area in The Monolith. This boss shares its appearance with the Clair enemy, but it has more powerful attacks, and far more Health points.

name: Clea
description: Clea is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Clea is one of the hardest bosses of the game and is located is on the Flying Manor, players will need to progress through the story to unlock Esquie's ability to fly to reach this location. It is also recommended to explore this location and fight Clea at around character level 85-90 plus.

name: Contorsionniste
description: Contorsionniste is an Enemy in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Its body is made of spiraling patterns. The head resembles a creature with a wide mouth and a single large red eye. Enemies feature a variety of hostile characters that players will encounter throughout their journey. These enemies come in different shapes and sizes, and have different attack styles and patterns.
obtain_locations: The Chosen Path (Encountered as a Boss)
related_rewards: Consistently drops Resplendent Chroma Catalyst and occasionally drops Recoat
notes: Contorsionistes have a large blood-shot eye embedded in their torso armor. The position of this eye changes depending on the current standing animation of the Contorsioniste, but striking this eye with a Free Aim shot deals immense damage (~18x multiplier). After a couple of hits to the eye, the Contorsioniste will change standing animations, potentially changing the eye location and/or making it more difficult to hit due to rapid movement.
After a couple of hits to the eye, the Contorsioniste will change standing animations, potentially changing the eye location and/or making it more difficult to hit due to rapid movement.
info_lines: Consistently drops Resplendent Chroma Catalyst and occasionally drops Recoat
The eye on its chest is its weak point, but after 2-3 hits on it, the creature will shift stances potentially making it more difficult to hit its weak point.

name: Creation
description: Creation is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Creation is a boss that has an appearance close to a horse with 4 scrawny legs, and hardened golden liquid on its body. This boss can be encountered at the Gardens in Lumiere.

name: Dualliste
description: Dualliste is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Dualliste is a large enemy that wields a longsword and appears to be burning from within. This boss does not have a visible weak point but is weak to Light Damage.

name: Eveque
description: Eveque is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Eveque is a boss that has multiple Shield instances that protect it from getting damage. This boss can summon two Abbests during the fight and primarily uses Weapon Attacks and a Spell Attack to inflict damage. Its weak point is at the center of its body and is weak to the Ice Element.
weak_spots: Black hole near the center of its body. Chest area.
info_lines: Available Weak Spot: Black hole near the center of its body. Chest area.
Other locations you encounter the Eveque: Endless Tower, Flying Manor

name: Frost Eveque
description: Frost Eveque is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Frost Eveque is a variation of the Eveque that has the power to inflict Cold Damage to its targets. This boss can be found by exploring The Continent, south from Stone Quarry entrance. The Frost Eveque is weak to Lightning damage, but is resistant to Dark Damage.
weak_spots: Yes, there is a glowing orb at the center of its chest. This is bugged however and will not register any extra damage.
info_lines: Available Weak Spot: Yes, there is a glowing orb at the center of its chest. This is bugged however and will not register any extra damage.
Powers up at 30% HP and becomes more aggressive. Uses a new Gradient Attack. The melee attack becomes faster while the timing on other attacks stays the same.

name: Gargant
description: Gargant is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Gargant is a large creature with rocks that make up its entire body. These rocks on the Gargant have golden markings on them, which appear to have grown from underground. The Gargant is unable to move the lower half of its body, which forces it to remain in the same place throughout the fight. Gargant has a unique combat mechanic that allows it to switch its stance between Fire and Ice, which alters the color of the flame appearing at the base of its body, as well as its resistances.
obtain_locations: From the Tainted Hearts checkpoint in Inside the Monolith, go towards the arch and cross the bridge all the way to the other side. From there, turn left where you see what looks like a destroyed part of a train carriage. Approach the shadow at the back to find Gargant.

From the Icebound Terminal Expedition Flag, cross over the bridge to the large arena and approach the Gargant to begin the fight. Defeat this boss to obtain Anti-Burn, Snowim, Eternal Ice, and Grandiose Chroma Catalyst x3.

Head to the Lampmaster area, then go to the left from the stairs. Use the grapple to reach the platform where is the boss. Don't forget to pick up the Energising Stun picto which is on the next platform.
info_lines: Weak Against: Fire Damage or Ice Damage
If you are frozen by this boss, you can shoot the orbs around it to dispel the effects of the affected character member.

name: Glissando
description: Glissando is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Glissando is a large creature with wrapped cloth covering its entire body, and its head appears to be a hollow shell. This boss is weak to Fire Damage. Glissando can be encountered near the Crumbling Path checkpoint in Sirene.
info_lines: Weak Against: Dark Damage, Ice Damage
Shoot the snake's rattling tail to weaken it.
If a character is charmed, you can shoot the tail to remove the effect.

name: Goblu
description: Goblu is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Goblu has long red hair with three painted masks in the middle. It mostly uses its limbs to attack and perform combos. Goblu is weak to the Lightning Damage and can grow multiple flowers throughout the fight that allow Goblu to generate shields.

name: Golgra
description: Golgra is an NPC and Optional Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. You will meet this NPC upon defeating the Ultimate Sakapatate, and entering the Chief House in Gestral Village. NPCs are supporting characters that players run into throughout the game. NPCs are found in various locations and play unique roles, such as specialists for certain services and quest-related roles such as quest givers.
notes: Golgra can be dueled in the Gestral Village by each character. Winning with each (except Gustave) will provide a level 27 weapon: Maelle: Medalum Lune: Trebuchim Sciel: Hevasson Monoco: Sidaro Verso: Sakaram
Maelle: Medalum
Lune: Trebuchim
Sciel: Hevasson
Monoco: Sidaro
Verso: Sakaram

Golgra is incredibly powerful, using rapid combos that deal extreme damage. She is substantially more powerful during the Gestral Village duels than in any other fights against her, except for the final fight of the Dark Gestral Arena.
It is recommended not to attempt the Gestral Village duels until much later in the game, generally at least level 50+, if not later.
On Expert mode, Golgra has about 6.5 million HP during her Gestral Village duels.

name: Jovial Moissonneuse
description: Jovial Moissonneuse is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Jovial Moissonneuse can be found in Visages. This is an enemy with the appearance of a floating head figure that is guarded by a variety of enemies that act as a shield.
info_lines: Weak Against: Dark Damage, Fire Damage
Easily missed if you do not take the Joyful Vale in Visages location.

name: Lampmaster
description: Lampmaster is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Lampmaster is an enemy that can be encountered inside a cave in the Stone Wave Cliffs. This boss uses the power of its lamps to unleash its attack, and the visible weak spot is the longer limbs and tendrils that shoot out from its body.
obtain_locations: From the Basalt Waves checkpoint in Stone Wave Cliffs, go inside the cave to the right and follow the trail of the lamp. You'll know you're in the right place when each time a lamp activates, it will create a sound. Continue to the end until you reach the pink lamp to discover the Lampmaster.
Obtain all three Items of the Beast and use it on the statue that is found in each Painting Workshop, it will unlock the arena to fight the Lampmaster.
Can also be fought in Stage 2, Trial 3 of the Endless Tower.
Can also be fought in Stage 11, Trial 2 of the Endless Tower.
info_lines: Shoot its lamps when it starts to power up to prevent it from using a strong attack.
When it lights up the lamps, watch closely for the pattern and shoot it according to the order of the lamps lit up.

name: Mask Keeper
description: Mask Keeper is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Mask Keeper can be encountered in Visages after defeating the boss in the area, which will play a cutscene that will reveal the true identity of the Mask Keeper. This enemy is weak to the Fire and Dark Damage.
info_lines: Weak Against: Dark Damage, Fire Damage
Before fighting the Mask Keeper in Visages, ensure that you take out its three primary masks found at the end of the three vales: Joyful Vale, Anger Vale, and Sadness Vale.

name: Moissonneuse
description: Moissonneuse is an Enemy in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. This enemy has pale white armor and wears a mask with a creepy, smiling expression. It carries a curved sword on its arm and has flowers adorning its head, giving it a strange, eerie look. Despite its delicate appearance, it is well-armored and dangerous in combat. Enemies feature a variety of hostile characters that players will encounter throughout their journey. These enemies come in different shapes and sizes, and have different attack styles and patterns.
related_rewards: Unique One time Drops/Rewards
notes: Some variants of the Moissonneuse takes 0.1x damage until stunned, during which they take 1.8x base damage (150% of the normal 1.2x stun damage multiplier).
Some variants of the Moissonneuse begin combat with the Berserk status.
info_lines: Enemy information, battle tips, skills, and guides for this enemy go here.

name: Seething Boucheclier
description: Seething Boucheclier is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Seething Boucheclier can be found in Visages. This is an enemy with the appearance of a floating head figure, it is guarded by a variety of enemies that act as a shield.
info_lines: Weak Against: Dark Damage, Fire Damage
Easily missed if you do not take the Anger Vale in Visages location.

name: Serpenphare
description: Serpenphare is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Serpenphare is a floating enemy with pink tail and various plants growing on its body. This boss has a unique mechanic that allows it to absorb all APs of the party, which allows it to attack multiple times. This boss can be found by exploring The Continent, Southeast of the Boat Graveyard. The Serpenphare is weak to Lightning Damage.

name: Sirene (Boss)
description: Sirene is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Sirene is the source of the voice that can be heard singing throughout Sirene. She has the power to call forth various creatures within her realm to attack the party. This boss does not have a visible weak spot and can inflict different damage types, such as Fire, Lightning, Ice, and Light. Sirene is weak to Dark Damage.
info_lines: Weak Against: Dark Damage, Ice Damage

name: Sorrowful Chapelier
description: Sorrowful Chapelier is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Sorrowful Chapelier can be found in Visages. This is an enemy with the appearance of a floating head figure that is guarded by a variety of enemies that act as a shield. This enemy can apply Exhaust to a target.
info_lines: Weak Against: Dark Damage, Fire Damage
Easily missed if you do not take the Sadness Vale in Visages location.

name: Sprong
description: Sprong is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Sprong is a giant creature that can be found in the water. The height of the Sprong is so tall that it can stand from the ocean floor, and attack the expedition who are standing on land. This boss can be found near a bit of coral, just west of the Blades' Graveyard. The Sprong is weak to Lightning Damage.
info_lines: Stunning it by breaking it when its Break bar is full will prevent it from using one of its phased attacks.

name: Thunder Eveque
description: Thunder Eveque is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Thunder Eveque is a variation of the Eveque that has the power to inflict Lightning Damage to its targets. This boss can be found by exploring The Continent, east of the Stone Wave Cliffs Cave entrance. The Thunder Eveque is weak to Earth damage, but is resistant to Dark Damage.
weak_spots: Yes, there is a glowing orb at the center of its chest.
info_lines: Available Weak Spot: Yes, there is a glowing orb at the center of its chest.

name: Tisseur
description: Tisseur is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Tisseur is a large creation, which, according to Verso, works for Sirene. This boss is not hostile immediately; you can initiate a conversation that will prompt a fight. This boss can cast a curse to target a character and ensure their death within a specific turn. Tisseur can be encountered at the Sewing Atelier in Sirene.
info_lines: Weak Against: Fire Damage, Light Damage

name: Ultimate Sakapatate
description: Ultimate Sakapatate is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Ultimate Sakapatate is an enemy with a large shield as tall as the boss on its left hand and a red furry mace on the right hand. This boss can be encountered in the open field under the large bell on the northern outskirts of the Ancient Sanctuary. The Ultimate Sakapatate is weak to the Fire Element.
info_lines: Not an Optional Boss at the Ancient Sanctuary.
Optional Boss at the Gestral Village and The Monolith.

name: Visages (Boss)
description: Visages is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Visages is a boss that can be encountered in Visages after defeating the 3 floating head figures, which are Jovial Moissonneuse, Seething Boucheclier, and Sorrowful Chapelier. This boss is made up of floating and detached slabs of stone that make up its entire body. It is weak to Fire and Dark Damage.
info_lines: Before fighting this boss, ensure that you take out its three primary masks found at the end of the three vales: Joyful Vale, Anger Vale, and Sadness Vale.

name: Chromatic Ballet
description: Chromatic Ballet is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Ballet is a trio of flying enemies in one. Each entity donning a different colour that represents their element variation. Each entity uses a different type of attack to damage its enemy while also being weak and resistant to different elements. It can be found in Falling Leaves, northwest of the Forgotten Battlefield.
obtain_locations: Location: Endless Tower: Stage 9 - Trial 1, Falling Leaves
info_lines: Weak Against: Fire Damage (Blue Entity), Dark Damage (Purple Entity), Ice Damage (Orange Entity)
Resistant to: Ice Damage (Blue Entity), Fire Damage (Orange Entity), Light Damage

name: Francois
description: François is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. François is a turtle with glowing blue mushrooms growing its exterior shell. It can cast Ice Element spells to inflict damage to its targets. François does not have a visible weak point.

name: The Paintress
description: The Paintress is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Paintress can be encountered for the first time near the entrance of The Monolith. However, the attacks will be useless at first and will require the party to explore inside The Monolith to find her. Once you find her again and engage in a true battle, she can recognize Verso and Maelle, as if she's related to them... During the fight, The Paintress can summon Void meteors, use Gradient attacks, and cast Chroma waves to inflict damage.

name: Renoir
description: Renoir (or White-Haired Man) is a Boss and NPC in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. This boss has the appearance of a normal human, just like the other expeditioners, except he's notable for his cane. This boss can use Light-based spells and conjure a sword of light to attack.

name: Chromatic Bruler
description: Chromatic Bruler is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Bruler has a large red shell on its back and uses a large hammer with that looks like an anchor for its weapon. This boss is weak to the Fire Element.
obtain_locations: Location: The Continent, northern area outside the Gestral Village. [See Expedition 33 Map]
weak_spots: Yes, the glowing orb inside the empty husk.
info_lines: Weak Against: Fire Element and Lightning Element
Available Weak Spot: Yes, the glowing orb inside the empty husk.

name: Chromatic Demineur
description: Chromatic Demineur is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Demineur shares its appearance with the regular enemy Demineur, and can also use the floating mine to attack its targets and inflict Burn effects. This boss can be found by exploring The Continent, north of the Stone Quarry.

name: Chromatic Gault
description: Chromatic Gault is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Gault wields a large hammer in its right hand and can perform swinging combos to attack its targets. This boss is resistant to Lightning Damage, Light Damage, and Darkness Damage. This boss absorbs Earth Damage.
info_lines: Resistant To: Lightning, Light, Darkness, Ice

name: Chromatic Lancelier
description: Chromatic Lancelier is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Lancelier is the boss version of the Lancelier enemies and can be encountered at the Spring Meadows. The weak point of this boss is at the top of its head, shaped like a diamond. It is also weak to the Ice Element.

name: Chromatic Jar
description: Chromatic Jar is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Jar is a boss that can be encountered by exploring The Continent, southwest of where the White Tree is located.
info_lines: Weak Against: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth
Available Weak Spot: Yes - Lantern on staff

name: Chromatic Luster
description: Chromatic Luster is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Luster is the boss version of the regular enemy Luster. This boss shares the same appearance with the base enemy but with magma around its head and the extremities of its limbs, and it can inflict the Burn effect. This boss consumes the active Burn effects to recover health.

name: Grosse Tete (Boss)
description: Grosse Tete (Boss) is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Grosse Tete is a rock creature with a large mask that covers the central part of its body. This boss can be found by exploring The Continent, in front of the Coastal Cave entrance. The Grosse Tete is weak to Dark damage.

name: Grown Bourgeon
description: Grown Bourgeon is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Grown Bourgeon is a tall creature that reaches as high as the ceiling. It primarily uses its fist by slamming it against its targets to inflict damage. This enemy is not hostile right away.

name: Alicia
description: Alicia is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Alicia can be found on the top of The Reacher, players will have to progress through the story to obtain Esquie's ability to fly, and also speak with Maelle at camp right before reaching a level 6 on your relationship level with her to unlock the conversation to begin her side quest. Alicia however also holds a major role in the story, being a painted form of Maelle's true self: Alicia Dessendre.

name: Simon
description: Simon is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Simon is one of the hardest bosses in the game and is located in The Abyss, which is within Renoir's Drafts. Players will need to get stronger and progress through the story to obtain Esquie's ability to swim underwater to reach this location. The recommended character level is 90+.

name: Chromatic Boucheclier
description: Chromatic Boucheclier is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Boucheclier is a three-headed skeleton that uses a shield to parry and nullify damage. It always starts the fight with shields, so it's best to bring shield breakers and to equip skills that break defenses and exploit its weaknesses when facing it.
obtain_locations: Location: Endless Tower: Stage 8 - Trial 2, Isle of the Eyes
info_lines: Weak Against: Fire Damage, Dark Damage

name: Chromatic Braseleur
description: Chromatic Braseleur is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Braseleur like its usual form, changes weaknesses depending on the damage it takes. It is a stronger version of the ones found in the Frozen Hearts area. Dodging the Chromatic Braseleur's attack is important as they deal heavy damage and can inflict Stun, while the orbs it shoots can Burn or Freeze the target.
obtain_locations: Location: Endless Tower: Stage 6 - Trial 2, The Reacher
info_lines: Weak Against: Ice Damage (during Fire Stance), Fire Damage (during Ice Stance)
Absorbs:, Ice Damage (during Ice Stance), Fire Damage (during Fire Stance)

name: Chromatic Catapult Sakapatate
description: Chromatic Catapult Sakapatate is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Catapult Sakapatate has a body of colourful patchwork fabric mounted on wheels that it uses to support its catapult-like mechanism. The Chromatic Catapult Sakapatate is accompanied by 2 other Gestrals during the fight and is weak to Fire Damage while resistant to Lightning Damage.
weak_spots: Yes. The hinges on the sides of the catapult.
info_lines: Available Weak Spot: Yes. The hinges on the sides of the catapult.

name: Chromatic Ceramic Chevaliere
description: Chromatic Ceramic Chevaliere is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Ceramic Chevaliere is a more visually striking version of its usual form. A tall. ornate ceramic-armored swordsman form of the Nevron wielding a large sword. It appears in the Endless Tower at Stage 10 - Trial 2 alongside the other two Chevalieres; the Chromatic Gold Chevaliere and the Chromatic Steel Chevaliere.
info_lines: Weak Against: Fire Damage, Ice Damage, Lightning Damage, Earth Damage, Dark Damage, Light Damage

name: Chromatic Chalier
description: Chromatic Chalier is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Chalier is a heavily armoured enemy with a pale complexion and a head seemingly made out of protruding rock and stone. The enemy wields a heavy large battleaxe-like weapon that it swings wildly. It is weak to Light Damage while resistant to Dark Damage.
obtain_locations: Location: Endless Tower Stage 10 - Trial 3, Sinister Cave

name: Chromatic Chapelier
description: Chromatic Chapelier is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Chapelier is a dark figure found in The Crows. Wielding a large heavy blade. The boss wears an ornate hat with carvings of faces on it with a scarecrow decorating it. The Chromatic Chapelier can summon and throw masks at a target that can Silence them if hit.
info_lines: Immune to: Dark Damage, Light Damage

name: Chromatic Clair Obscur
description: Chromatic Clair Obscur is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Clair Obscur is a large harrowing figure of red cloaked in sharp darkness that serves as its armour. The Boss wields a sword of fragmented darkness. Its visage seemingly cleaved in half down the middle of its body. It is important to focus on dodging and parrying as the boss deals heavy damage when it attacks; additionally, it can also inflict debuffs and status effects such as Powerless, Defenceless, and Silence.
obtain_locations: Location: Endless Tower Stage 11 - Trial 2, The Monolith

name: Chromatic Creation
description: Chromatic Creation is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Creation is a stronger variation of the normal boss. It stands on four legs with its body a swarm of bodies cloaked in shadows. It can be found in Renoir's Drafts. Just like its normal variation, the Chromatic Creation inflicts Inverted at the start of the fight which causes the party to take damage when receiving any healing.

name: Chromatic Cruler
description: Chromatic Cruler is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Cruler can be found in the Endless Night Sanctuary. An optional boss with a large stature, it thankfully has a fairly simple and limited attack pattern to keep track of. The boss is resistant to Lightning Damage, but can inflict both Burn and Stun on the party members.

name: Chromatic Danseuse
description: Chromatic Danseuse is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Danseuse resembles the polar opposite of the normal Danseuse. Its form is bathed in darkness, and encountering it can be a bit tricky, as it changes stances that correlate to which element it is weak to and what element it absorbs.
obtain_locations: Location: Endless Tower Stage 9 - Trial 3, Old Lumiere
info_lines: Weak Against: Fire Damage (during Ice Stance), Ice Damage (during Fire Stance)
Absorbs: Fire Damage (during Fire Stance), Ice Damage (during Ice Stance)

name: Chromatic Eveque
description: Chromatic Eveque is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Eveque is a stronger variant of the normal boss found in the Flying Manor. This variant, however, is found in the Endless Tower, accompanied by a Chromatic Ballet and a Braseleur. Its attacks deal large damage and hit multiple times, so it's important to focus on dodging and parrying to minimize the damage.
info_lines: Resistant to: Fire Damage, Lightning Damage, Physical Damage, Light Damage

name: Chromatic Glaise
description: Chromatic Glaise is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Glaise resembles a giant that is fused with rocky terrain. Its form is hulking and broad, and the boss starts the fight with multiple shields that must be broken before being able to deal damage to its health bar. It is resistant to Lightning Damage, absorbs Earth Damage, and is weak to Fire and Ice Damage.
obtain_locations: Location: Endless Tower Stage 8 - Trial 3, Sky Island
info_lines: Weak Against: Fire Damage, Ice Damage

name: Chromatic Gold Chevaliere
description: Chromatic Gold Chevaliere is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Gold Chevaliere can be found in two locations: the Crimson Forest and the Endless Tower as the notable enemy in Stage 7 - Trial 2 and Stage 10 - Trial 2. In the Crimson Forest, the Chromatic Gold Chevaliere is accompanied by two other enemies: a Clair and an Obscur. In the Endless Tower, it is accompanied by the other two Chevalieres: the Chromatic Ceramic Chevaliere and the Chromatic Steel Chevaliere It is weak to Light and Dark Damage while it is resistant to Fire and Ice Damage.
obtain_locations: Location: Endless Tower Stage 7 - Trial 2 and Stage 10 - Trial 2, Crimson Forest
info_lines: Weak Against: Light Damage, Dark Damage
Resistant to: Fire Damage, Ice Damage

name: Chromatic Hexga
description: Chromatic Hexga is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Hexga is a tank of an enemy that will test your build and strategy. It can be found in the Stone Wave Cliffs Cave. The longer the fight goes on with this enemy, the more formidable it becomes, with the crystal on its left shoulder changing colour to indicate the stages of the fight. Once the crystal turns red, Chromatic Hexga will become invulnerable to all damage, and you must shoot at the crystal until it changes colour to deal damage again.
weak_spots: Yes. The crystal on its shoulder can be shot at when it's not glowing to stun the Chromatic Hexga, and it can be shot at when it's turned red to remove the boss's invulnerability.
info_lines: Immune to: (When the crystal on the Chromatic Hexga's shoulder turns red) All

Available Weak Spot: Yes. The crystal on its shoulder can be shot at when it's not glowing to stun the Chromatic Hexga, and it can be shot at when it's turned red to remove the boss's invulnerability.

name: Chromatic Ranger Sakapatate
description: Chromatic Ranger Sakapatate is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Ranger Sakapatate is a stronger variant of the usual form with a body round and made of patchwork fabric like a stuffed doll. It is the second enemy in the Dark Gestral Arena. It will be accompanied by two other Gestrals during the fight and is weak to Fire and resistant to Lightning Damage
info_lines: Available Weak Spot: Yes. Its left shoulder.

name: Chromatic Robust Sakapatate
description: Chromatic Robust Sakapatate is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Robust Sakapatate is the third enemy in the Dark Gestral Arena and like the other variants, it has a body made of ragged patchwork-like fabric. It is weak to Fire and resistant to Lightning Damage and also starts the fight with shields that protect its health bar from taking damage.

name: Chromatic Steel Chevaliere
description: Chromatic Steel Chevaliere is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Steel Chevaliere can be found in the Endless Tower alongside the Chromatic Ceramic Chevaliere and the Chromatic Gold Chevaliere at Stage 10 - Trial 2. It is weak to Physical Damage.

name: Chromatic Veilleur
description: Chromatic Veilleur is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Chromatic Veilleur is a towering, scrawny figure that holds up a lamp that can be found in Frozen Hearts by the Glacial Falls sub-area; the same area where The Manor door is located. It can also be encountered in the Endless Tower in Stage 5 - Trial 1. It can inflict Blight which reduces the party's HP which you can remove by shooting the glow in its lantern. It is important to deal Light and Lightning Damage as it is vulnerable to it.
obtain_locations: Location: Endless Tower Stage 5 - Trial 1, Frozen Hearts
weak_spots: Yes. The glowing in its lantern can be shot at to remove the Blight status inflicted on the party
info_lines: Weak Against: Light Damage, Lightning Damage
Available Weak Spot: Yes. The glowing in its lantern can be shot at to remove the Blight status inflicted on the party

name: Flame Eveque
description: Flame Eveque is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Flame Eveque is another variant of the Eveque that has the power to inflict Fire Damage on its targets. It is found in the Flying Manor where the boss will be accompanied by the Frost Eveque and the Thunder Eveque—and the Endless Tower. It is resistant to all elements except for Void Damage and it is weak to Ice Damage.
obtain_locations: Location: Endless Tower Stage 7 - Trial 1, Stage 9 - Trial 3, Flying Manor
info_lines: Resistant to: Physical Damage, Light Damage, Dark Damage, Earth Damage, Lightning Damage

name: Painted Love
description: Painted Love is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Painted Love can be found in Stage 11 - Trial 3 at the Endless Tower. They are considered a duo boss that share the same health bar and stun bar, but each entity takes status effects separately. They have no weaknesses or immunities. Because of their shared health bar, it's wise to use attacks that target multiple enemies.

name: Scavenger
description: Scavenger is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The Scavenger can be found in Falling Leaves after completing the quest in the location. It is weak to Light Damage and can be affected by Physical Damage but is resistant to all other types of elements and will absorb Dark Damage.
info_lines: Resistant to: Ice Damage, Fire Damage, Earth Damage, Lightning Damage

name: Chromatic Lampmaster
description: Chromatic Lampmaster is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. The enhanced version of the Lampmaster, is an enemy that uses the power of its lamps to unleash its attack. This version can be encountered in the Thank You Update, a free DLC in Expedition 33.

name: Simon the Divergent Star
description: Simon the Divergent Star is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Simon, the Divergent Star, located inside the Endless Tower, is the enhanced version of the original Simon in The Abyss. Now with more health and more difficult attack patterns, players will have to maximize their builds and stats as well as demonstrate mastery in parrying to defeat Simon.

name: Clea Unleashed
description: Clea Unleashed is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Clea Unleashed is the new and much more difficult boss fight found inside the Endless Tower. Featured in the newest DLC: Thank You Update, players must have mastery over parrying to get through to her.
notes: Lore, Notes & Other Trivia goes here
info_lines: Players will need to have defeated the base Clea before having access to Clea Unleashed.

name: Duollistes
description: Duollistes is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Duollistes is the new and more difficult boss fight in the DLC: Thank You Update. The Duollistes, composed of two Duallistes, are quick and formidable enemies that merge into one in their second phase. Players will need to have mastery over parrying and dodging to get through the Duollistes.

name: Licornapieds
description: Licornapieds is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Licornapieds is a boss exclusive to the Thank You Update, and highly resembles the Machinapieds enemy. You can get the Frenzy Picto as a reward from this boss after defeating it.

name: Chromatic Machinapieds
description: Chromatic Machinapieds is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Chromatic Franctale is a boss exclusive to the Thank You Update, and is the Chromatic version of the Machinapieds enemy.

name: Chromatic Franctale
description: Chromatic Franctale is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Chromatic Franctale is a boss exclusive to the Thank You Update, and is the Chromatic version of the Franctale enemy.

name: Chromatic Barbasucette
description: Chromatic Barbasucette is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Chromatic Barbasucette is a boss exclusive to the Thank You Update, and is the Chromatic version of the Barbasucette Enemy. It drops the weapon called the Sucetton, which is a weapon specifically for Sciel.

name: Half-Baked Gestral
description: Half-Baked Gestral is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. This boss is known as Romanifo. A Gestral who loves Balloons. This boss fight is quite unique since you don't deal damage to the boss itself. You can deal damage by popping the balloons they spawn.

name: Osquio
description: Osquio is a Boss in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Osquio is a boss exclusive to the Thank You Update, he claims to be the ultimate cake eater of the universe and is also Esquie's cousin. He can be found in his sanctuary in the Root of all Evil, within Verso's Drafts.
obtain_locations: Location: Verso's Drafts, Root of all Evil
